positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Lead Firmware Performance Tester. Wrote automated validation tests for Solid State Drive firmware.  Created and executed scripts for Firmware Performance Analysis.
•	Earned lead role in SSD Firmware Performance testing.  Responsible for all performance testing in the SSD Firmware Test group.
•	Communicated product performance to Firmware Development team, Senior Level Management, Customer Relations, and other groups outside of Firmware Engineering.
•	Performed requests for Firmware Development team, Modeling team, and others who had a vested interest in Firmware Performance.  Gathered system level data against any requirement that was requested.  Modified tests according to these requests.
•	Created a performance testing suite to analyze the firmware bandwidth, command completion rate, and latency using VDBench, IOMeter, and Oakgate testing tools.
•	Reported on test results in PowerPoint, Excel, through Email, and via a custom website.
•	Wrote a Visual Basic add-in for Excel which parsed performance test outputs.  Programmed script to put all of the data in a readable format, analyze data, and graph various workloads.  Reduced analysis time and eliminated the chances of human error.
•	Tracked firmware performance for every release.  Analyzed which changes affected performance according to developer calculations.
•	Managed 20+ test stations for SSD performance testing.  Coordinated station use during busy times with multiple firmware releases, each with different test plans.
•	Developed automated software tests in C++ for firmware feature validation.  Identified issues and provided the development team with information to help resolve those issues efficiently.
•	Validated OEM and customer specific features.  Ensured high firmware quality by communicating frequently with firmware design and customer relations teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Conceived, developed, and maintained integration tests for the defibrillator and pacemaker Firmware Development team.  Provided software tooling support for the testing environment.
•	Developed automated integration tests in C++ and Python to verify firmware implementation ensuring that the design and requirement specifications were met.  Discovered dozens of firmware issues prior to release, which was targeted to save millions in post-formal rework or product recalls.
•	Considered a Subject Matter Expert on several firmware features.  Served as a resource for engineers who had questions about features.
•	Mentored a summer intern on a static analysis baselining project to determine new firmware violations of coding conventions using QA-C tool.  Significantly cut the cost of performing static analysis by eliminating the need for sifting through and reanalyzing existing violations.
•	Enhanced software tools including rewriting metadata code generator in Perl, validating QA-C tool for formal use, automating commenting of software test libraries using Doxygen, and automating execution of all of these tools.
•	Participated in 6 project testing formals for submission to the FDA that resulted in another product on the market.
•	Recruited summer interns on the Rose-Hulman Institute of Technology’s campus.  Conducted interviews and helped select over 20 applicants for multiple departments.
•	Authored an integration test results report for a $100,000 dollar project submitted to the FDA.  The report was accepted on its first submission attempt, avoiding costly rework and saving time.

positions.title: Software Engineering Co-op
positions.description:
Developer on a 3 month contract to create a web-based router management project for Cyan Optics.
•	Developed a tool in Javascript and Python to maintain routers from remote locations.
•	Programmed the capability to display router information using a user-friendly graphical interface and allowed the user to control various aspects of the router.
•	Became part of a team in the exciting new technology of fiber optic networks.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Completed a 3 month project to automate fault analysis in tests for the Firmware Validation team.
•	Developed a Python tool to automate fault analysis in firmware tests by parsing through test results and interpreting relevant messages.
•	Integrated program which allowed fault analysis to occur earlier in development as well as more frequently, which means that firmware issues can be detected earlier in the development cycle.
•	Presented project and results to engineering team and upper-level management.  The project was received with enthusiasm and estimated to produce $90,000 worth of work annually.
•	Reduced the number of faults which required manual analysis by 80%.
•	Resulted in adopting a new method of fault analysis and an offer for me to return to the company full-time.
